title: ioc-group Helm chart
description: Helm chart for deploying a group of EPICS IOCs that differ only by environment variables

iocs.description: One entry per IOC instance in this group. Each entry is a map of environment variables appended to ioc-instance.env for that instance alone. Every entry MUST include NAME - its value is appended to the release name to make that IOC's Kubernetes resources unique, and NAME must be unique within the group.
